exposure: Caesarean section (CS) with infant in cephalic position
Infants conceived through assisted reproductive technology
caesarean section (CS) with the infant in cephalic position
outcome: mRNA expression levels of OCT4B1, IGF2, MEST, and PEG10 in umbilical cord blood
finding: There were no significant differences in the mRNA expression levels of OCT4B1, IGF2, MEST, and PEG10 in umbilical cord blood between different modes of delivery and conception.
mod_finding: The expression and methylation patterns of OCT4B1, IGF2, MEST, and PEG10 in umbilical cord blood were not affected by the mode of delivery.
